comments.author: minesettimi
comments.body_html:
the default time is setup to be a max of 1 hour for a delay but the delay is based on the position in queue and the demand, so you’re less likely to see the higher times if you’re selling low.

as for an item’s selling chance, it is based on the configured demand, but even sometimes items can not sell even if they have high demand. however, with the deal system, based on the configured amount the lower than minimum you get the higher the sell chance until its 100%.

the mods behavior is 100% configurable, if you prefer the vanilla system you can even turn off the custom sell system, it is up to how you want it to function. the default config does need work but icba to play tarkov for a long time right now just to get it the finely tuned testing needed

comments.author: Super_Lopez
comments.body_html: Why do you need flea simulator if you already can conect your game and have real flea prices?

comments.author: minesettimi
comments.body_html:
The live prices fluctuate with IRL events which can be undesirable at times, especially where there’s a desync between live tarkov’s state and your SPT game. For example, when this mod was made certain items weren’t unlocked yet on the live flea due to the level restrictions which caused certain items to be worth 40m+ roubles bc that was the last price that got set before the 1.0 wipe. Additionally, if items are restricted on the live flea and not SPT then they will not have their prices change at all and function as vanilla.

This mod aims to have a middle ground that allows for full configurability and connection with your game with the downside that prices won’t ever have the real dynamics and fluidity of real prices. Ultimately, up to personal preference but id rather have the choice be possible for those who want it.
